name: Breagh
text: Breagh is a variant spelling of Brega. Brega was a plain in east central Ireland. The reader who meets this form should consult the Brega entry for the fuller account.

okr.objective: Explain the spelling Breagh and direct the reader to the Brega entry.
key_results: Breagh is an alternate form of Brega.
Brega was a plain in east central Ireland.
The fuller account sits under the name Brega.
